name: md-mermaid-pane
description: A pane that shows a Markdown file with its mermaid blocks drawn as diagrams, redrawn when the file changes

nodePath.title: Node
nodePath.description: The node that runs the mermaid renderer. Leave 'node' when node is on PATH; else its full path (which node).

npmPath.title: npm
npmPath.description: The npm /md-view-setup installs the renderer with. Leave 'npm' when it is on PATH; else its full path.

chromePath.title: Chrome / Chromium / Edge
chromePath.description: The browser the renderer drives. Empty finds Chrome, Chromium or Edge in their usual install places.
